description: Reassignment only: Sort newly assigned, unscheduled tasks by reward and task ID. For each consecutive three-observation segment, try both cyclic reorderings, placing those incoming tasks first. When broken edges exist, only segments containing a broken-edge endpoint are tried; when neither incoming tasks nor broken edges exist, return null. Evaluate edits through C and return the feasible issued trial with highest profit, within the evaluation limit. This case does not implement initialization.
